svg.text: where every jumper sits and what its positions mean · details on the per-jumper cards
closed = CW resets chip · open = SW1 only
1-2 CW308 filter (✓ SCA) · 2-3 U2 LDO direct
▸ SCA capture — board mounted on CW308
JP1 closed · JP3/JP5 → 1-2 · JP4/JP6 → 1-2 · JP7 → 1-2 FILTERED
J6 → 3-5 (CW drives S-Sel) · J10 → 2-4 · J12 → 3-4 (clock echoed on J7.5)
JP1 open · JP3/JP5 → 2-3 · JP4/JP6 → 2-3 · JP7 → 2-3 DIRECT
J6 → 1-3 (module drives S-Sel) · J10 → 2-4 · J12 → 3-4 OSC 50M
Always: set R20 for 0.8 V core BEFORE inserting the chip · white dot = pin 1.
J12: exactly one source link · CW308 J3 stays empty — J7.5 carries the clock echo.
